scope: Recover missing PRHC event citations and one explicitly bounded ministerial-responsibility period. No claim of complete PRHC history or an independent corporate logo.

sources.title: BC Housing Annual Report 2000-2001
sources.review_method: Downloaded PDF; rendered target page and visually checked typography.
sources.claim: The PRHC financial-statements section uses widely spaced orange capitals in a narrow ruled box.
sources.date_basis: The retained year 2001 is the end year of reporting period 2000/01.
sources.limits: Section-heading typography does not establish a separate logo or a logo-adoption date; exact publication date not established.

sources.title: PRHC Financial Statements, March 31, 2023
sources.review_method: Official PDF text and rendered page reviewed.
sources.claim: Ownership of the Riverview land and buildings transferred from Citizens’ Services to PRHC on 2 February 2015 at book value.
sources.date_basis: Explicit transfer date, distinct from the statements’ 2023 reporting date.
sources.limits: An asset transfer does not imply a renamed corporation or changed brand.

sources.title: Order in Council 177/1998
sources.locator: Approval on PDF page 1; appendix section 15, printed page 2 / PDF page 3
sources.review_method: Downloaded official scan; visually checked approval stamp and section 15.
sources.claim: The housing minister’s responsibilities move to Employment and Investment on 18 February 1998.
sources.limits: The printed name Provincial Rental Housing Commission is retained as a source discrepancy and resolved against the contemporary Auditor General account. Statutory administration is separately addressed in section 16.

sources.title: Order in Council 897/1999
sources.locator: Approval on PDF page 1; appendix section 23, printed page 4 / PDF page 5
sources.review_method: Official PDF text reviewed; section 23 rendered and visually checked.
sources.claim: Responsibilities move onward to Social Development and Economic Security on 21 July 1999.
sources.limits: This closes the researched Employment and Investment period. No interval after this date is asserted. The order again prints Commission rather than Corporation.
